name: Look
description: Changes how tabs look. A star marks a tab whose agent finished while you were in another tab, until you go back to it. Claude reports weighted progress with set_steps, shown as a progress chip on its tab: the share of the work done, not the count of steps.
author: Flare

tools.name: set_steps
tools.description: Shows the progress of a multi-step job on the tab you run in, weighted by how much work each step is. Send every step each time; an empty list takes the progress off. Answers with the value shown, 0 to 1.

name.description: What the step is, for the tooltip.

weight.description: How much of the work it is, more than 0 (default 1).
